facts.value: Enters common Passive motion state 199, conditionally normalizes airborne Fighter state, and issues sound, ground-knockback, asynchronous effect and color-animation requests. This void entry operation is distinct from the upstream eligibility query.
facts.rationale: Canonical body and active callback table establish entry identity without unresolved gameplay terminology or guaranteed presentation success.

facts.value: Reads Fighter from gobj->user_data and calls ftCommon_8007D7FC only for GA_Air. Then calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState with 199/Ft_MF_None/start 0/speed 1/blend 0/NULL; ft_800881D8 with configured x24 sound and 127/64; ft_PlaySFX with 3/127/64; ftCommon_8007CCE8; ftCo_SpawnEf with TopN joint/1/1053; and ftCo_800BFFD0 with 120/false, in order. The effect adapter passes &fp->x60C to efAsync_Spawn. Color-animation bool success is ignored. There is no local eligibility guard, rollback, lifetime validation or error return.
facts.rationale: Replaces guaranteed feedback language with exact arguments, sequencing and request semantics.

evidence.why: Ordered body and absence of checks.

facts.value: Implements common Passive state entry and its Anim, IASA, Phys and Coll callbacks. Entry requests state and presentation initialization; Anim conditionally dispatches completion, IASA is empty, and Phys/Coll delegate shared movement and collision behavior.
facts.rationale: Complete source and active table establish the TU role without an unsupported neutral-tech mapping.

facts.value: Entry conditionally normalizes GA_Air, selects Passive state 199 at start 0/speed 1/blend 0 and issues sound, knockback and presentation requests. Anim calls ft_8008A2BC only when ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining is false; that dispatcher has boss and alternate ordinary-fighter paths rather than universally entering Wait. IASA does nothing. Phys delegates to ft_80084F3C, scaling friction only for ABS(gr_vel)>walk_max_vel before friction and ground movement. Coll delegates to ft_80083F88, which enters Fall when ft_80082708(gobj)==GA_Ground. Therefore animation is not the only possible exit; the support predicate's physical meaning remains unresolved.
facts.rationale: Preserves exact local/delegated behavior and boundaries without global interruption or presentation-success claims.
